name: Stargate (OpenAI/SoftBank/Oracle/MGX venture)
description: Joint venture announced Jan 2025 to build AI data centers for OpenAI in the US; equity from SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX.
explain: Stargate is the vehicle OpenAI and its partners use to fund AI data centers, with a stated plan of $500 billion over four years. SoftBank has financial responsibility and OpenAI operational responsibility. hq_state reflects a US entity; no HQ city has been announced.
